title: 可再生能源机遇
summary: 评估公司在可再生能源领域的装机容量、发电量占比与技术研发。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Opportunities in Renewable Energy Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Opportunities in Renewable Energy is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for renewable power through capacity additions and network expansion.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍可再生能源机遇关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。可再生能源机遇属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。公司评估考察其通过新增装机容量与网络扩张满足可再生电力市场需求的布局与能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_cn: 可再生能源机遇关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Renewable Energy Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, opportunities on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that the Exposure score determines the weight placed on the Management score, ranging from 50% (when the Exposure score is equal to zero) to 100% (when the Exposure score is equal to 10).

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Renewable Energy Strategy score
sections.title_cn: 可再生能源机遇战略得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Renewable Energy Strategy score evaluates the company’s initiatives to expand renewable energy capacity through strategic investments, internal structures, and quantitative targets. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 可再生能源机遇战略得分评估公司通过战略投资、内部组织架构和量化目标扩大可再生能源装机容量的举措。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Targets to increase renewable capacity
sections.title_cn: • 增加可再生能源装机容量的目标

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed quantitative targets to increase renewable energy capacity. Includes targets referring to owned capacity only, i.e., excluding purchasing agreements. Applies to companies with an electricity generation business only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否披露增加可再生能源装机容量的量化目标。仅包括自有装机容量目标，即不包括购买协议。仅适用于开展发电业务的公司。

sections.title_en: • Internal structures to develop renewable capacity
sections.title_cn: • 开发可再生能源装机容量的内部组织架构

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s established internal structures related to developing renewable capacity. Best practice is to have a dedicated renewable energy subsidiary or be wholly involved in renewables. Applies to companies with an electricity generation business only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司为开发可再生能源装机容量建立的内部组织架构。最佳实践是设立专门的可再生能源子公司，或全部业务均涉及可再生能源。仅适用于开展发电业务的公司。

sections.title_en: • Investments to increase connection of renewable power to electric grid
sections.title_cn: • 增加可再生电力并网的投资

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has made investments related to the increased connection of renewable power to the electric grid. Applies to companies with an electricity transmission or distribution business only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否作出增加可再生电力并网的相关投资。仅适用于开展输电或配电业务的公司。

sections.title_en: • Score of planned additional renewable electricity generation relative to current total capacity
sections.title_cn: • 计划新增可再生能源发电量相对于当前总装机容量的得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on ratio of planned additional renewable electricity generation to current total capacity. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司计划新增可再生能源发电量与当前总装机容量之比的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: ◦ Current Total Installed Capacity (MW)
sections.title_cn: ◦ 当前总装机容量（兆瓦）

blocks.content: Definition: The current amount of installed capacity for power generation in megawatts (MW).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：当前发电装机容量，单位为兆瓦。

sections.title_en: ◦ Additional renewable capacity (MW)
sections.title_cn: ◦ 新增可再生能源装机容量（兆瓦）

blocks.content: Definition: The amount of capacity in megawatts (MW) that an issuer has disclosed as planned additions which are renewables.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：发行人披露的计划新增可再生能源装机容量，单位为兆瓦。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Renewable Energy Programs & Initiatives score
sections.title_cn: 可再生能源机遇项目与举措得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Renewable Energy Programs & Initiatives score evaluates the company’s initiatives to expand renewable energy opportunities through customer green power options and commercialization of renewable power equipment. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 可再生能源机遇计划与举措得分评估公司通过向客户提供绿色电力选项及推动可再生能源发电设备商业化，扩大可再生能源机遇的举措。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Commercializes renewable power equipment
sections.title_cn: • 可再生能源发电设备商业化

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company implements programs that involve the installation of equipment used in renewable energy generation.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否实施涉及安装可再生能源发电设备的计划。

sections.title_en: • Offers customers a green power option
sections.title_cn: • 向客户提供绿色电力选项

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company offers its customers the option to purchase power from renewable generation sources. Applies to companies with an electricity supply business only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否向客户提供购买可再生能源电力的选项。仅适用于开展供电业务的公司。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Renewable Energy Performance score
sections.title_cn: 可再生能源机遇绩效得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Renewable Energy Performance score evaluates the company’s performance on opportunities in renewable energy metrics (including renewable capacity and percentage change in the proportion of renewable capacity to total generation capacity) relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0- 10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 可再生能源机遇绩效得分评估公司相关指标相对于同行的表现，包括可再生能源装机容量，以及可再生能源装机容量占总发电装机容量比例的百分比变化。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: • Renewable power capacity performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同行的可再生能源装机容量表现

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on total renewable energy power capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity), and trend in renewable energy power capacity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司可再生能源总装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）及其变化趋势相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: ◦ Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 可再生能源装机容量得分（占总装机容量的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on installed renewable power capacity expressed (as a percentage of total installed capacity). Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司可再生能源装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity)
sections.title_cn: • 三年平均可再生能源装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average installed renewable capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司可再生能源装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: ◦ Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) industry relative trend score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 可再生能源装机容量趋势行业相对得分（占总装机容量的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s three-year average of year-over-year installed renewable power capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司可再生能源装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均值相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average renewable power capacity trend (% of total installed capacity)
sections.title_cn: • 可再生能源装机容量趋势的三年平均值（占总装机容量的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year installed renewable capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity) trend.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司可再生能源装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Renewable Energy Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 可再生能源机遇风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Renewable Energy Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to opportunities on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest opportunity and 0 corresponding to the lowest opportunity. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 可再生能源机遇敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的机遇敞口，以业务和地域敞口得分为基础。地域敞口得分作为业务敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务与地域敞口得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高机遇水平，0 分对应最低机遇水平。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险敞口分析”章节。敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ { O R E , i } = B U S _ { O R E , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( G E O _ { O R E , i } - 5 \big ) )
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: $E X P _ { O R E , i }$ is the Opportunities in Renewable Energy Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $E X P _ { O R E , i }$ 为公司 i 的可再生能源机遇敞口得分。

blocks.content: $B U S _ { O R E , i }$ is the Business Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $B U S _ { O R E , i }$ 为公司 i 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: $G E O _ { O R E , i }$ is the Geographic Exposure score of company i.

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure scores
sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. The Business Segment Exposure score is determined by a qualitative assessment of whether a business activity has a core involvement in power generation. A higher involvement will result in a higher exposure score for the business activity.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部敞口得分。该得分通过定性评估业务活动是否以发电为核心业务确定；参与程度越高，业务活动敞口得分越高。

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by the incentives provided by a country or market to expand renewable power generation capacity.
blocks.content_cn: 地域分部敞口得分由国家或市场为扩大可再生能源发电装机容量提供的激励措施确定。

blocks.content: The following types of regulatory, fiscal and public financing incentives are considered for the Total Incentives score:
blocks.content_cn: 总激励得分考虑以下监管、财政及公共融资激励类型：

blocks.content: 1. Feed-in tariffs
blocks.content_cn: 1. 上网电价补贴

blocks.content: 2. Tradable energy certificates
blocks.content_cn: 2. 可交易能源证书

blocks.content: 3. Renewable portfolio standards
blocks.content_cn: 3. 可再生能源配额标准

blocks.content: 4. Capital subsidies, grants or rebates
blocks.content_cn: 4. 资本补贴、拨款或返还

blocks.content: 5. Investment tax credits
blocks.content_cn: 5. 投资税收抵免

blocks.content: 6. Sales tax credits
blocks.content_cn: 6. 销售税抵免

blocks.content: 7. Tax exemptions/reductions
blocks.content_cn: 7. 税收豁免或减免

blocks.content: 8. Public investment loans
blocks.content_cn: 8. 公共投资贷款

blocks.content: 9. Public competitive bidding
blocks.content_cn: 9. 公共竞争性招标

blocks.content: The Total Incentives score measures the number of incentives provided by a country. Provision of more incentives results in a higher opportunity score for a country or market.
blocks.content_cn: 总激励得分衡量国家提供的激励措施数量。提供的激励措施越多，该国家或市场的机遇得分越高。

blocks.content: The Renewable Energy Outlook for a country or market is based on a qualitative assessment by MSCI on the planned renewable capacity additions and investments in renewable power generation in the country or market.
blocks.content_cn: 一国或市场的可再生能源展望，以 MSCI 对该国或市场计划新增可再生能源装机容量及可再生能源发电投资的定性评估为基础。

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Opportunities in Renewable Energy Exposure score: Refinitiv, MSCI S&C, company disclosures, Renewable Energy Policy Network for the 21st Century.
